rationale: ObjC second-review wave: OC-F same-file enum cases read as values (case labels, comparisons, returns; NS_ENUM lives in headers behind macros), OC-G @protocol directive silence, OC-H file-scope function names as decay/read targets. Every pin probe-verified against both the analyzer and deriveObjcEdges before pinning; lanes confirm the pair agrees on corpora. OC-E BINDING SPELLING (family contract, DARTD8; `BINDING_SEP` + `metadata.localBinding`, src/ast/types.ts:190). A unit-local read names a binding, not a declaration: the store publishes no parameters or locals, so the bare name could never be answered, and where a same-named declaration existed elsewhere in the project the read was bound to THAT declaration. The pin below is the spelling the analyzer actually emits, read off `binding-spelling-dump.ts`. Pre-change copy preserved as `second-review.expectation.superseded-fb93f6f18.json`.
